name: CL Educate Ltd
title: CL Educate Ltd - 540403 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: CL Educate H1 FY27 EBITDA rose to ~₹57 crore (margin ~18.6% vs 15.7%) on 4% revenue decline to ₹305 crore, with PAT back positive.
summary.overview: H1 FY27 revenue fell about 4% to ₹305 crore from ₹319 crore, driven by EdTech (down ~13%) and DEXIT base effects from rollover contracts in Q1 FY26. Cost actions cut overheads by about ₹12.5 crore, lifting EBITDA from ~₹50 crore to ~₹57 crore and margin about 3 percentage points, with PAT returning to positive (up ~350%). Management flagged ~₹172 crore of new multi-year DEXIT contract wins, of which ~₹40 crore accrues in FY27, and a pending DEXIT merger into CL Educate. Overall tone was upbeat on H2 but the call gave few hard forward numbers.

segments.name: EdTech (Learning & Development)
segments.commentary: Revenue down ~13% on test prep market flattening; EBITDA up ~8% with margin about 21-22% vs 17%, helped by overhead cuts and a shift toward franchise/network channels with higher ARPU. CL Media (platform monetisation) flat in H1, with admission-cycle seasonality shifting to start in October.

segments.name: DEXIT (Digital Assessments)
segments.commentary: Revenue down ~8% (about ₹10-11 crore), mainly due to Q1 FY26 rollover contracts not recurring; Q2 roughly flat vs Q1. EBITDA down ~2% in absolute terms with margin up ~171 bps. New wins include IIT GATE (shared with an existing vendor), GPSC, Bihar Civil Services, Edsel; IIBF and DGFMS renewed for 2-3 years.

segments.name: MarTech (Kestone/VOSMOS/VIRSA)
segments.commentary: Revenue up ~14% and EBITDA up ~26-27%; international about 40%, India about 60% of revenue. Large Dell events; Infosys signed for a global implementation; talks with other IT majors over the next 6-12 months.

guidance_outlook: Overhead savings of about ₹20-22 crore expected in the current fiscal year, with the H2 contribution tempered versus H1's ₹12.5 crore.
Management expects H2 FY27 numbers to look significantly better than H2 FY26, with a significant portion of the ~₹40 crore FY27 DEXIT contract accrual landing in H2.
CL Media expected to have a solid H2 with significant revenue growth and a reasonably positive EBITDA margin.
EdTech revenue expected to stay around current levels for about one more year, with margin flat to slightly up.
Merger tax savings estimated at ₹11-15 crore annually for three years, plus ₹3-5 crore annual admin/overhead savings.
Long-term debt repayment expected at ₹24-30 crore a year absent equity raise or other events; ₹100 crore NCD refinancing to complete in 4-6 weeks.
DEXIT merger via NCLT expected to complete by roughly September-October 2027 (9-15 month estimate), with timing uncertain.
capex_capacity: Management is increasing capacity to qualify for NEET and other exams; NEET moving to CBT mode announced by government, with the expert committee blueprint expected around January 2027.
mySathi: about 15,000 tests executed to date; target 25,000 students over next 4-5 months and 35,000-40,000 by year-end.
Registered office shifted to Mumbai (INC-22 approved); DEXIT merger scheme approved by both boards, NCLT filing expected this month.
₹203 crore DEXIT redeemable preference shares redeemed in mid-August after NCLT approval in July, trimming balance sheet by over ₹200 crore.
demand_pricing: Test prep market flattening across segments, affecting most test prep players including those outside CL's segments.
DEXIT exam pricing ranges from about ₹150 to ₹1,200 per student depending on services and sessions; ~80 lakh exams done last year on ~₹230 crore revenue (about ₹300 per exam on average).
IIT GATE sees 8-10 lakh students a year; DEXIT empanelled for the first time, sharing orders with an existing vendor.
Offline assessments market cited at ~₹2,500 crore in 2023 growing ~8% CAGR, with a projection of ~₹3,500 crore in a couple of years.
Pilots planned with 3-5 corporates in BFSI/IT over 3-6 months for corporate internal exams.

qa_highlights.question: Update on mySathi and its scale?
qa_highlights.answer: Gautam Puri said it is in pilot and expected to launch fully in the coming season; Nikhil Mahajan said ~15,000 tests done with 35,000-40,000 students targeted by year-end.

qa_highlights.question: Tax and other savings from the DEXIT merger, timeline, and route?
qa_highlights.answer: Management chose the NCLT route over fast-track; estimated 9-15 months at Bombay NCLT. Tax savings ₹11-15 crore annually and other overhead savings ₹3-5 crore annually.

qa_highlights.question: Yatrik Vin's status and succession at DEXIT?
qa_highlights.answer: Gautam Puri said Yatrik Vin resigned from the CL Educate board for health reasons but remains DEXIT chairperson; succession exists but he is expected to stay for the next three to six months.

qa_highlights.question: DEXIT contract duration and right of refusal?
qa_highlights.answer: Harshit Maniar said contracts typically run 2-3 years; some are reverse e-auctions where DEXIT can match the lowest price, others are fixed-price bids that cannot be revised.

qa_highlights.question: Capital raise at DEXIT level and DEXIT IPO?
qa_highlights.answer: Nikhil Mahajan said options remain open until the merger takes effect (12-15 months); an IPO is unlikely if the merger proceeds, but an equity offer could change the course.

qa_highlights.question: NEET CBT shift and DEXIT's revenue opportunity?
qa_highlights.answer: Gautam Puri said NEET (about 20 lakh students) moves to CBT and will likely be split among multiple vendors; Harshit Maniar said the committee sought inputs and the report is expected around January 2027.

qa_highlights.question: UG vs PG mix and when revenue and margins stabilise?
qa_highlights.answer: Gautam Puri said UG and PG are about 50-50 now, with UG expected to grow; revenues likely flat around current levels for about a year, then rising, with margins steady or slightly up.

qa_highlights.question: Debt outlook for the next two years?
qa_highlights.answer: Arjun Wadhwa said annual repayments are ₹24-30 crore, long-term acquisition debt about ₹174 crore and working capital about ₹55-60 crore at 30 September; the company aims to become net debt-free.

risks_watch: EdTech top-line decline (~13%) from test prep market flattening; revenue guided flat for about a year.
DEXIT H1 revenue decline and reliance on new contract ramp-up (₹172 crore wins, ~₹40 crore in FY27).
NEET CBT award split and timing depend on the expert committee report (expected January 2027).
NCLT timing for DEXIT merger is uncertain (9-15 months; some cases 15-18 months).
Refinancing of ₹100 crore acquisition loans via listed NCDs to complete in 4-6 weeks.
Yatrik Vin's health and succession at DEXIT.
Overhead savings tapering in H2 relative to H1.
summary.management_tone: Confident on margins and H2 recovery, with specific figures on savings and contract wins. Cautious and deliberately non-committal on NEET volumes, merger timing, DEXIT capital options and the Yatrik Vin succession, deferring several questions to later updates.
key_quotes: As you can see, our EBITDA margin has expanded by about 3 percentage points from the same time last year.
The total multi-year contract wins, as we speak, aggregate to about ₹ 172 crores, which will get delivered over the next two to three years.
But on an overall basis, I think we should be able to reflect total cost savings of around ₹ 20 to 22 crores on overheads during the current fiscal year, during the remaining part of H2.
We have expressed in the past our desire to be a net debt -free company as soon as possible, and we continue to work towards that.

adds.what: Capacity increase to qualify for NEET and other exams (no size given)
mySathi test platform: target 25,000 students in 4-5 months, 35,000-40,000 by year-end (from ~15,000 tests executed)

growth.why: Management guides to H2 FY27 DEXIT revenue expansion over prior-year H2 backed by ~₹40 crore of the ₹172 crore new contracts accruing in FY27, and ₹20-22 crore overhead savings for FY27 H2, but gives no firm revenue number; EdTech is expected flat for about a year, so overall growth outlook is only modestly positive.
